body_markdown:
Today’s supply chain and operations professionals face a dual challenge of controlling costs while maintaining high-level service. So, what do these professionals need from their transportation and logistics partners?


We found the answers in a recent survey of 150 supply chain and operations leaders, conducted by Werner and Supply Chain Dive’s studioID. They’re looking for providers that deliver stability amid uncertainty and provide the required service levels and visibility to meet cross-border challenges.


There are many choices for transportation providers in the market, but the complexities of the modern supply chain have shippers looking beyond the lowest rates for more strategic partnerships.


[Click here](https://www.werner.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/09/FINAL-Werner_Infographic_Design_06202025-1.pdf) to see more.
